# Spec - atdd-hook-pilot

## Summary

- **Goal:** the client-observable hook scenarios of `tests/test_directory_validator.py` and `tests/test_hook_failure_matrix.py` run as executable specifications over a DSL and protocol drivers, through both hook clients.
- **Approach:** the `atdd` skill's three stages. Stage 1 (this define stage) writes the specifications, the DSL, the alias helper and the driver interface and factory, ending in an import red. Stage 2 (implement) writes the Claude Code, Codex and CLI drivers. Stage 3 (verify) moves the old tests, proves isolation and writes the note. Each stage stops for the owner's review.
- **Why now / what changes:** splitting `hooks/pre-tool.sh` changed about 25 test files whose behavior did not change. No shipped file changes.

## Intent links

| Intent | Scenarios |
|---|---|
| INT-1 | TRC-P1 |
| INT-2 | TRC-P2 |
| INT-3 | TRC-P3, TRC-P4 |
| INT-4 | TRC-P5 |

## The hook scenarios moved

`tests/acceptance/hooks/test_hook_refusals.py` holds 16 scenarios (40 cases for each client with their parameters), each with its Given/When/Then lines in its docstring:

| Specification | From |
|---|---|
| an edit whose checks all pass is allowed | HFM-1 control |
| a check that cannot run refuses and names itself | HFM-1 readers |
| the red record refusal gives its cause | HFM-1 red cause |
| with no python3 the refusal says so | HFM-2 |
| a temporary file that cannot be made refuses | HFM-1 mktemp |
| settings that do not parse refuse and name the fix | HFM-3 |
| a shell write refusal names the file it found | HFM-3 Bash |
| code globs of the wrong shape refuse | CGS-1 |
| unreadable settings still refuse | HFM-1 unreadable config |
| a missing approach record is reported as missing | HFM-4 |
| a missing Python helper refuses in a project | HFM-1 missing helper |
| a missing Python helper stays silent in a guest repository | HFM-1 guest |
| a missing part refuses every call | TRC-A3 missing part |
| an unreadable part refuses every call | TRC-A3 unreadable part |
| an unreadable helper still refuses a code edit | TRC-A3 unreadable helper |

Not moved, because no client observes them: TRC-A1, TRC-A2 and the standard-input check of TRC-A3 (they read the hook's source), HFM-5 (the safety contract's text), HFM-6 (retired words in the source), and TRC-B and TRC-C (command files and environment, checked in-process).

## Scenarios

### Scenario: the hook scenarios run as layered specifications

<!-- traceability id: TRC-P1 · serves: INT-1 -->

```gherkin
Given the 16 hook scenarios in tests/acceptance/hooks/test_hook_refusals.py
When the DSL and the specifications are searched
Then the DSL holds 0 calls of assert, expect or should
And every specification line is one DSL call
And every scenario passes through the Claude Code driver
```

### Scenario: the same specifications run through both hook clients

<!-- traceability id: TRC-P2 · serves: INT-2 -->

```gherkin
Given the specifications
When they run with COMPASS_HOOK_CLIENT=claude-code and with COMPASS_HOOK_CLIENT=codex
Then every scenario passes under both, with 0 changes to the specifications
```

### Scenario: a change to the hook's layout changes only the driver

<!-- traceability id: TRC-P3 · serves: INT-3 -->

```gherkin
Given a planted change that moves one hook part to another folder
When the acceptance suite is fixed for it
Then only files under tests/acceptance/hooks/drivers/ change
```

### Scenario: the suite runs in parallel and twice

<!-- traceability id: TRC-P4 · serves: INT-3 -->

```gherkin
Given the acceptance suite
When it runs on 4 parallel workers, and one scenario runs twice in a row
Then all 3 runs give the same result, with 0 failures
```

### Scenario: the note measures the result

<!-- traceability id: TRC-P5 · serves: INT-4 -->

```gherkin
Given the moved tests and the old ones
When a hook-layout refactor is counted against each
Then the note gives the number of test files it touches before and after, and a recommendation for ayeo-io/compass-delivery#307
```

| Concern | Scenario | Reason it does not apply |

| performance | | The pilot moves tests; the suite's runtime is measured in the note, not gated |
| capacity | | No stored data |
| compatibility | TRC-P2 | |
| security | TRC-P1 | |
| privacy | | No personal data |
| operability | TRC-P4 | |
| accessibility | | No user interface |
